Job Description

We are looking for a skilled Bubble.io developer to build a secure, mobile-first web app for our clients. The application will be accessed primarily on smartphones via physical QR code scans on magnets.

We have a complete, interactive Figma prototype ready to review. Your job will be translating this design into a fully functioning, responsive Bubble app with database privacy controls and automated real-time data exports.

Design Reference

Figma Interactive Prototype: https://www.figma.com/make/5mcLRrfdVs1NbBNWdWsRrJ/Client-Access-QR-Code?fullscreen=1&t=k7rL9ejxsFGY4J5a-1&code-node-id=0-6

**Front-end UI build in Bubble.io must visually match the layouts, colors, and button placements established in the Figma design across mobile Safari and Chrome.**

Core User Workflows & App Architecture

1. Passcode Gate & Security:

* User lands on the app via QR scan containing a secret URL parameter.

* SEO blocking (`noindex` & `robots.txt`) configured to keep the app hidden from search engines.

* Client logs in by entering a **4-letter passcode** (the first 4 letters of their street address).

* Verified against a client database table before unlocking the main dashboard.

2. Main Menu (4 Action Buttons):

Button 1: Order / Refill Prescription

Button 2: Request Documents

Button 3: Instructions, How-to, Procedures (Secondary menu displaying viewable/(non-downloadable) PDF documents).

Button 4: Clinical After Hours Support - Form submission "Tap to Call" phone link if field are filled out and recorded in .csv

3. Data Pipeline (Google Sheets / CSV Sync):

All form submissions across Prescription Refills, Document Requests, and After-Hours Support must automatically update a live **Google Sheet** (or generate an exportable CSV dataset via Bubble Backend Workflows) in real time or hourly.

Developer Responsibilities

Translate provided Figma layouts into responsive Bubble pages using the modern Flexbox engine.

Set up database architecture, relationships, and strict Data Privacy Rules Privacy to prevent unauthorized web scraping/browser inspection.

Implement address passcode authentication logic and telephone protocols.

Set up real-time Google Sheets / CSV sync via plugins or scheduled backend workflows.

Conduct end-to-end testing across mobile iOS Safari and Android Chrome.

---

Project Structure & Payment

This project will be managed via Fixed-Price Milestones:

1. **Milestone 1:** Database Architecture, Passcode Auth & Security/SEO Lockdown (Database Architecture, Security & Authentication, setup database schema & client tables, build address passcode authentication logic, configure noindex SEO shielding & Data Privacy Rules)

-25% of budget allocation

2. **Milestone 2:** Responsive UI Build (Figma Implementation) & Navigation (Translate Figma wireframe screens into Bubble. build Passcode Gate, 4-Button Main Menu, PDF viewer, & submenus. Mobile responsive layout testing (iOS & Android).

-25% of budget allocation

3. **Milestone 3:** Form Workflows, Google Sheets / CSV Data Pipeline & Click-to-Call (Forms, Real-Time Data Pipeline & Call Triggers, Build input forms for Prescription Refills, Documents, & After-Hours, Configure real-time Google Sheets / CSV backend sync, Set up "Tap to Call" phone action for after-hours care.)

-25% budget allocation

4. **Milestone 4:** Mobile QA Testing, Bug Fixes & App Transfer

-25% budget allocation

Total Project Fixed Price: $1000.00 (CAD)

About Us

The Harbors Video Project (THVP) opens a window on the underwater world through exploration, research, and education. With over 3,500 hours of recorded video and 5,000+ species observations mapped across our local waters, we are building an interactive "Explore" platform. Our goal is to make the life beneath our coastal waters visible and understandable to the people who live, play, and work near them.

The Role

We are looking for a creative, science-minded Social Media Coordinator to help us drive traffic to our interactive website and engage a growing community of ocean lovers, divers, and educators. In this phase, you will not just be posting pictures; you will be turning our massive video library of raw underwater footage and associated observation data into social media content that encourages people to visit, explore, and provide feedback on our digital platform as well as partner with us for educational, scientific or conservation purposes. We are looking for someone who will bring ideas, test them, and learn from what works.

We are looking for someone part-time who can spend around 10 hours/week to get us started. Down the line, this could grow into more. Early success will be measured primarily by whether the content gets people exploring the site, interacting with THVP, providing useful feedback, and returning - not simply by follower counts.

Key Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Optimization: Edit and optimize raw underwater clips into compelling social media videos.

Interactive Content Creation: Craft engaging captions and interactive stories that encourage users to visit our Explore site to research the local waters or learn more, or to partner with us.

Audience Engagement & Feedback: Manage our social feeds, respond to comments, spark conversations about marine biology and exploration, and actively prompt followers for feedback on our website's user experience.

Testing & Learning: Track which content and calls to action actually drive visits to Explore, interaction, feedback, and return engagement, and use those results to refine the content mix.

Channel Management: Schedule and publish content 2–3 times per week across our priority social media channels, using a focused initial mix that fits the available 10 hours/week.

Qualifications & Experience

Background in Marine Science: A degree, relevant coursework, professional experience, or demonstrated strong foundational knowledge in Marine Biology, Environmental Science, Oceanography, or a closely related field. You must be able to write scientifically accurate, educational captions.

Video Editing Workflow: Experience editing engaging, fast-paced social media video.

Time Management: Proven ability to work independently, prioritize effectively within an initial 10-hour weekly budget, and use efficient workflows and templates.

Software Experience Bonus: Experience with DaVinci Resolve is beneficial, as we are planning on standardizing on this for remote video production. An understanding of basic color correction for underwater footage is a major plus.

How to Apply

In your message, please look at our interactive website (https://explore.theharborsvideoproject.org) and pitch us one or two creative ideas on how you would use our existing video library and data to actively engage people and get them exploring the platform. Briefly explain why you think the ideas would work and what you would look at to judge whether they are driving meaningful engagement. Also tell us which platforms you would prioritize first and why.

IMPORTANT: Please apply only if you are genuinely capable of managing the entire project described below from beginning to end. I am not looking for professionals to handle individual parts of the work. I need one person capable of taking ownership of and coordinating the complete development. If you do not have the skills and experience required to cover all the areas described below, please do not apply.

I am looking for an experienced Product Development / Mechanical Design Engineer with strong DFM and industrialization skills who can take an existing physical product and bring it from prototype stage to a genuinely manufacturable small-series product.

I am NOT looking for a purely theoretical designer. I need someone practical, adaptable and solution-oriented — someone who does not simply identify problems, but proposes realistic, cost-effective and manufacturable solutions.

The product is already developed: I have a physical prototype, CAD/3D models, electronics, firmware and the mechanical structure. You will NOT be starting from zero.

The project has three main areas:

1. PLASTIC PARTS / DFM OPTIMIZATION

Some current components are manufactured using 3D printing and CNC/router machining. I want to preserve the existing industrial design while redesigning the main parts for faster and more cost-effective production.

Main components:

- central console → ideally 2 molded shells, upper/lower;

- hanger → ideally 2 molded shells, front/rear;

- base cover → one component or an extremely simple assembly.

The engineer should evaluate the most suitable manufacturing process (thermoforming, vacuum casting, molding or other solutions), considering initial production batches of approximately 20–40 units and low tooling investment.

2. SANITIZING / FRAGRANCE UPGRADE MODULE

The base product already uses forced airflow, hot/cold air, automatic cycles, electronics and app control.

I want to develop an additional compact module for sanitizing/deodorizing and fragrance using atomization/nebulization or another effective solution.

It must be modular: the same platform should be available as a base version or with the upgrade module, ideally allowing the upgrade to be installed later as well.

3. CUSTOM PACKAGING

Design a professional custom packaging solution, ideally a carrying case with internal protection, suitable for transporting the disassembled product and economically manufacturable in relatively small initial quantities.

FINAL OBJECTIVE

I do not want only renders or theoretical concepts. At the end of the project I want a complete package that can actually be used to move into production:

- final CAD/STEP files;

- DFM-ready parts;

- BOM and technical specifications;

- files required for prototyping and manufacturing;

- clear manufacturing process recommendations;

- ideally identification and contact details of real manufacturers/suppliers for plastic molding and custom packaging.

I am open to manufacturers in Asia or other regions where good quality can be achieved while keeping tooling and production costs low.

I own a 3D printer, so during development I can quickly prototype parts, brackets and design modifications myself. This allows us to work iteratively: design → print → test → modify, without outsourcing every prototype.

I am looking for ONE PERSON capable of managing and coordinating the complete development.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

- proven mechanical/product development experience;

- strong DFM and plastic manufacturing knowledge;

- ability to design around real manufacturing costs;

- mechanical/electronic integration capability;

- ability to identify or evaluate manufacturers and suppliers;

- practical and solution-oriented mindset;

- consistent and reliable communication;

- ability to respect deadlines.

CONFIDENTIALITY

An NDA is attached and must be signed before the complete technical material is shared.

Confidentiality is extremely important to me. CAD files, images, technical information and any details regarding the product must not be disclosed, shared or used outside this project.

BUDGET & LONG-TERM COLLABORATION

My budget is currently limited because I have already invested significantly in developing the prototype. I am therefore looking for a professional with realistic and accessible pricing who knows how to achieve concrete results using the available resources efficiently.

I am not looking for beginners or recent graduates. This is a real and already advanced product, so I will consider candidates with solid, demonstrable experience.

I do not necessarily see this as a one-off project. If I find someone capable, consistent and reliable, with whom I work well, I would be very interested in continuing the collaboration long-term and growing together as the business and future products develop.

TIMELINE: approximately 1 month. I would like this development phase completed by November.

When applying, please briefly provide:

- confirmation that you understand the complete scope and can personally manage the entire project;

- your experience taking physical prototypes into production;

- how you would approach the work;

- realistic timeline;

- preferably a fixed-price proposal.

I am looking for someone who can genuinely take ownership of the project and turn it into something that can actually be manufactured while preserving the design, low production costs and original objectives.

Job Description

We are looking for a skilled Bubble.io developer to build a secure, mobile-first web app for our clients. The application will be accessed primarily on smartphones via physical QR code scans on magnets.

We have a complete, interactive Figma prototype ready to review. Your job will be translating this design into a fully functioning, responsive Bubble app with database privacy controls and automated real-time data exports.

Design Reference

Figma Interactive Prototype: https://www.figma.com/make/5mcLRrfdVs1NbBNWdWsRrJ/Client-Access-QR-Code?fullscreen=1&t=k7rL9ejxsFGY4J5a-1&code-node-id=0-6

**Front-end UI build in Bubble.io must visually match the layouts, colors, and button placements established in the Figma design across mobile Safari and Chrome.**

Core User Workflows & App Architecture

1. Passcode Gate & Security:

* User lands on the app via QR scan containing a secret URL parameter.

* SEO blocking (`noindex` & `robots.txt`) configured to keep the app hidden from search engines.

* Client logs in by entering a **4-letter passcode** (the first 4 letters of their street address).

* Verified against a client database table before unlocking the main dashboard.

2. Main Menu (4 Action Buttons):

Button 1: Order / Refill Prescription

Button 2: Request Documents

Button 3: Instructions, How-to, Procedures (Secondary menu displaying viewable/(non-downloadable) PDF documents).

Button 4: Clinical After Hours Support - Form submission "Tap to Call" phone link if field are filled out and recorded in .csv

3. Data Pipeline (Google Sheets / CSV Sync):

All form submissions across Prescription Refills, Document Requests, and After-Hours Support must automatically update a live **Google Sheet** (or generate an exportable CSV dataset via Bubble Backend Workflows) in real time or hourly.

Developer Responsibilities

Translate provided Figma layouts into responsive Bubble pages using the modern Flexbox engine.

Set up database architecture, relationships, and strict Data Privacy Rules Privacy to prevent unauthorized web scraping/browser inspection.

Implement address passcode authentication logic and telephone protocols.

Set up real-time Google Sheets / CSV sync via plugins or scheduled backend workflows.

Conduct end-to-end testing across mobile iOS Safari and Android Chrome.

---

Project Structure & Payment

This project will be managed via Fixed-Price Milestones:

1. **Milestone 1:** Database Architecture, Passcode Auth & Security/SEO Lockdown (Database Architecture, Security & Authentication, setup database schema & client tables, build address passcode authentication logic, configure noindex SEO shielding & Data Privacy Rules)

-25% of budget allocation

2. **Milestone 2:** Responsive UI Build (Figma Implementation) & Navigation (Translate Figma wireframe screens into Bubble. build Passcode Gate, 4-Button Main Menu, PDF viewer, & submenus. Mobile responsive layout testing (iOS & Android).

-25% of budget allocation

3. **Milestone 3:** Form Workflows, Google Sheets / CSV Data Pipeline & Click-to-Call (Forms, Real-Time Data Pipeline & Call Triggers, Build input forms for Prescription Refills, Documents, & After-Hours, Configure real-time Google Sheets / CSV backend sync, Set up "Tap to Call" phone action for after-hours care.)

-25% budget allocation

4. **Milestone 4:** Mobile QA Testing, Bug Fixes & App Transfer

-25% budget allocation
